To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CO-labels are not a sufficient strategy to increase the demand of BAVARIANA BEEF.
the interaction between the analysed labels is mostly negative or no interaction at all.
BAVARIAN, AUSTRIAN and IRISH BEEF are the preferred origins in the German beef market and that BAVARIANS BEEF and IRISH BIFES are the most preferred beef products.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question, how the interaction between Country-Of-Origin and QUALITY & SAFTY labels influences the promotion of beef in Germany.
a deeper analysis of the effects of the interaction of different labelling strategies in the promotion of BEEF products.
the identification of labelling strategies that can be used in the promotion of beef.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CO-labels are more important for the promotion of BEEF than QUALITY & SAFETy-Certificates, but that there are exceptions.
the combination of a QUALITY & SAFETYLABEL with a specific COO is not necessarily a good strategy for the promotion of beef in Germany.
the analysed QUALITY and SAFETY certificates are not effective in supporting the sales of BEEF in general.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CO-labels and QUALITY & SAFEY-certificates have an impact on consumer preferences, but that the impact is rather limited.
the labelling strategy for BEEF products should be a combination of Country-of-Origin and retailer brands.
the interaction of COs with QUALITY & SAFET labels is rather complex.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effectiveness of a labelling strategy depends on the specific combination of labels.
the interaction between CO, brands and certificates is not a priori given.

the interaction between Country of Origin, QUALITY & SAFE-TY labels, retailer brands, and individual specific data is complex and needs to be analysed in more detail to identify the best labelling strategy for the German beef market.
